title: Senior Software Engineer - Session Replay | Canada | Remote
description:

Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X .

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

This is a remote opportunity and we would be interested in applicants from Canadian Eastern time zones only at this time.

Senior Software Engineer - Session Replay

The Opportunity:

The Session Replay squad is building a new Grafana Cloud product that helps our customers to understand what users actually experienced when something goes wrong.

Session Replay connects frontend signals (errors, performance, synthetic checks) to concrete session-level evidence, enabling faster and more confident investigation of production issues.

This team works at the intersection of:

• frontend observability,

• backend data processing and storage at scale,

• debugging workflows across products,

• privacy and access control,

• performance and cost constraints at scale.

Session Replay is still early, which means you’ll help shape both what we build and how it fits into Grafana Cloud. A key part of our next phase is evolving the backend architecture of capturing sessions, including a migration toward columnar/analytical solution as a primary storage and query engine for high-volume session data.

As a company we are remote-first and global, we embrace people of different experiences and backgrounds to build diverse teams where every person brings a new perspective to the software. We are looking for Senior Software Engineers who are passionate about working with data and providing seamless experiences for our customers to join our growing team! Our stack is Golang, Typescript and React, but we build tools for people using many other stacks. 

What You’ll Be Doing:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will operate as a technical leader and systems thinker, driving both product direction and architectural evolution, specifically, you will:

• Own end-to-end technical direction for Session Replay, spanning frontend, backend, and data systems

• Drive the evolution of our backend architecture, including:

• Designing systems around columnar/analytical data storage for large-scale session data  

• Defining data models, ingestion pipelines, and query patterns

• Lead the design of investigation workflows, connecting replay with logs, metrics, traces and other telemetry across Grafana Cloud

• Make high-leverage architectural decisions that impact multiple teams and products

• Partner with teams across Grafana (Frontend Observability, Synthetic Monitoring, Core Grafana) to build cohesive cross-product experiences

• Engage directly with customers - joining calls, gathering structured feedback, and helping customers instrument and adopt Session Replay successfully.

title: PROGRAM CONTROL ANALYST III
description:

The Project Control Analyst 3 (PCA3) supports project teams by monitoring schedule, cost, and performance from project initiation through completion. This role uses a variety of project control tools and techniques to track timelines, milestones, budgets, and expenditures. Working closely with project managers and key stakeholders, the PCA3 helps identify and resolve issues, recommends corrective actions, and ensures projects remain on schedule and within scope. The PCA3 maintains accurate project documentation, prepares routine and ad hoc reports, and provides essential analytical support to the project management team.
Additionally, the PCA3 is responsible for financial tracking in support of government contracts, including development and reconciliation of Estimates at Completion (EACs), analysis of financial data, and compliance with applicable regulations. The ideal candidate will be proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint, possess strong verbal and written communication skills, and demonstrate the ability to multitask, work under pressure, and meet monthly deliverable deadlines.
As with any position, additional expectations exist. • Use a variety of tools and techniques to monitor the progress of a project from start to finish. This includes everything from tracking timelines and milestones to monitoring budgets and expenses.

• Review all contract set ups in the company accounting system at the start up stage to confirm set up is done correctly.

• Track, analyze and report progress on contracts of varying size and complexity with limited supervision.

• Responsible for capturing costs incurred and commitments and comparing against plans.

• Maintain and track WBS (Work Breakdown Structure) efforts as required by contract.

• Assist with the development and implementation of project management processes and tools.

• Support the project team members in the planning, tracking, analyzing, and reporting of projects of varying contract type, size, complexity, and level of risk.

• Conduct post-project reviews to document lessons learned and make recommendations for future projects.

• Manage special projects as assigned by the project manager or senior management

• 15+ years’ experience in a Project Control Analyst/Project Financial Analyst role working with government service contracts.

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

- Establish performance budgets and guardrails integrated into CI/CD so regressions are caught before they ship.

- Mentor engineers across the org on performance best practices, conduct reviews of critical performance paths, and build a culture where teams own performance as a quality attribute.

- Represent Snowflake's frontend performance perspective in cross-org architectural decisions (e.g., API design, service infrastructure, caching layers) where frontend impact is significant.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 8+ years of software engineering experience, with deep expertise in web performance for larg

description:

Apprenti is an inaugural Department of Labor Apprenti ceship Ambassador and a Department of Labor Apprenti ceship Intermediary in the U.S. Registered Apprenti ceship System.

POSITION SUMMARY

As the Sales Enablement and Marketing Business Partner, you will have two critical workstreams.

You will serve as the bridge between Apprenti ’s Business Development, Product and Marketing Teams and our external partners. You will oversee and activate all outbound sales campaigns through Salesforce’s Marketing Cloud in collaboration with our National Sales Leader and our Marketing Team. You will serve as the Sales Team’s partner to help define and move marketing requests to production through the Marketing Team.

This role is critical to ensuring our marketing and sales efforts are aligned with our Big Bets and focused on results.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

•
Drive Strategy Alignment: Proactively identify and diagnose marketing and sales enablement gaps across the business development and product teams, translating them into actionable strategies.

•
Marketing Request Vetting & Qualifying: Serve as the primary gatekeeper for marketing requests, vetting and qualifying them against business objectives to ensure resources are focused on high-impact activities.

•
Capture Customer Voice: Collaborate with stakeholders to capture the customer voice through case studies and PR initiatives highlighting apprentice pipeline success.

•
Optimize Sales Readiness: Ensure that the sales team is fully equipped to go to market by leading collateral distribution, training, and sales enablement material development.

•
Execute Campaigns & Compliance: Drive the end-to-end execution of sales campaigns, ensuring they run on schedule and meet compliance requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

• 6+ years of professional experience in B2B marketing, sales enablement, or business development (10+ years preferred)

• Proficiency in CRM and CRM marketing tools to manage sales campaigns and understand sales cycles, forecasting, and methodologies. (Salesforce and Marketing Cloud Experience Preferred)

• Proven track record of managing cross-functional projects among internal and external stakeholders, and closing go-to-market gaps.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated experience presenting effectively to executive stakeholders, key decision-makers, and senior leaders.

• Deep understanding of workforce development, education, or tech sectors

• Balanced strategic thinking with high attention to detail, including the ability to increase speed-to-market using AI toolsets effectively and responsibly.

• Proven ability to drive alignment of both external and internal stakeholders in a complex operational environment.

• Self-motivated with a high level of integrity, trustworthiness, and initiative to operate effectively in a remote environment during standard business hours.

• Ability to travel 20% for sales and community outreach events.

WHAT WE OFFER

Apprenti pays a gross annualized base salary range for this position between $90,000 to $120,000 Placement within this range is determined by the candidate's qualifications, skills and relevant experience. In addition, this role’s compensation includes variable commissions for target achievement.

We offer the following key benefits for this full-time role:

• Company-paid medical, dental, vision, and life insurance for employees AND their dependents

• Generous HSA company contributions for those who elect the high-deductible plan

• Flexible and self-managed PTO program, plus 11 company holidays, and a week-long mid-year break

• 401(k) program with 4% company match, after 90 days of employment

title: Forward Deployed Engineer (SPECTR) - Clearance Required
description:
Overview
LMI is seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to deploy, integrate, and extend SPECTR , our mission-focused asset visibility and sensor platform supporting Department of Defense customers. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who can work directly with users, understand operational problems, and rapidly turn requirements into working technical solutions. You’ll operate at the intersection of software engineering, systems integration, and field delivery-configuring deployments, integrating customer systems and data, troubleshooting across the stack, and building new capabilities when configuration alone isn’t enough.
This position requires an active Secret clearance. LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.
Remote (U.S.-Based) | 50-75% Travel Required
We’re looking for an engineer who likes building where the mission happens. You’ll work directly with DoD customers and alongside our Product, Mission Engineering, and core engineering teams to get SPECTR working in real-world environments. Some problems will require configuration. Others will require an API integration, script, deployment change, or new software capability. Your job is to figure out what’s needed, build it, validate it with users, and help turn field solutions into repeatable product capability.
Responsibilities

• Deploy, configure, integrate, and validate SPECTR in customer environments.

• Work directly with DoD users to understand mission workflows, technical constraints, and operational pain points.

• Integrate SPECTR with customer systems, APIs, databases, data sources, networks, and mission applications.

• Build production-quality integrations, APIs, scripts, automation, and software capabilities to solve field requirements.

• Troubleshoot issues across applications, databases, containers, cloud infrastructure, networking, and connected edge systems.

• Support technical demonstrations, pilots, field tests, and operational deployments.

• Partner with Field Product Leads to translate operational needs into technical solutions and Capability Requests.

• Work with core engineering teams to transition useful field-developed capabilities into the SPECTR product.

• Document configurations, technical solutions, and lessons learned to make future deployments faster and more repeatable.

• Travel approximately 50-75% to DoD installations and other customer locations.

Qualifications
What We’re Looking For

• Active DoD Secret clearance.

• 4+ years of software engineering, systems integration, solutions engineering, or similar technical experience.

• Strong development skills in C#, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or similar languages .

• Experience developing and integrating REST APIs and working with relational databases/SQL.

• Hands-on experience deploying and troubleshooting production software.

• Experience with Linux, Docker, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Familiarity with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS/AWS GovCloud.

• Strong understanding of networking fundamentals and distributed system troubleshooting.

• Ability to translate ambiguous customer requirements into working technical solutions.

• Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with technical and operational DoD stakeholders.

• Ability to operate independently, solve problems quickly, and work effectively in field environments.

• U.S. Citizenship required.

• Ability to travel 50-75%.

Bonus Points For

• Experience delivering software or integrated systems in DoD environments.

• Experience with RFID, IoT, sensor systems, edge computing, or asset tracking .

• Experience with .NET/C#, AWS GovCloud, Kubernetes, Terraform, or GitLab.

• Familiarity with RMF/ATO, IL5/IL6, or other DoD cybersecurity requirements.

description:
The Koch Internship Program (KIP) is a paid experiential learning program run by Stand Together Fellowships that offers professional development, leadership training, and meaningful work experience at non-profits tackling some of our nation's most pressing policy challenges all over the United States. Early-career professionals including undergraduate/graduate/law students and recent graduates are encouraged to apply. Eligible candidates will be geographically located in and authorized to work in the United States through the duration of the program. Successful candidates will interview with both our non-profit partner organizations and Stand Together Fellowships staff, so we strongly encourage you to begin the admissions process early!

About Competitive Enterprise Institute:
 
The Competitive Enterprise Institute is a nonprofit think tank based in Washington which focuses on critical economic and regulatory policy issues.
 
CEI’s internship program provides interested students and recent graduates the opportunity to learn about and promote the principles of limited government, free enterprise, and individual liberty. A CEI internship gives applicants the opportunity to work alongside some of the most prominent regulatory affairs scholars and policy specialists.
 
CEI offers a number of internships across the various policy areas we work on, as well as internships in communications and marketing. Generally, CEI’s policy interns are assigned to work with a specific CEI expert for the duration of their internship; and our communications and marketing interns work with the CEI staff of each respective team.
 
CEI’s internship program is an invaluable educational experience. We work with interns to help them grow professionally, hone their skills, and cultivate lasting relationships. Ultimately, our goal is to give interns work that will help them further their careers. Interns are encouraged to be proactive, and exceptional interns are often given the freedom to shape their experience with us and the possibility to explore other opportunities at CEI.
 
Past CEI interns have gone on to work in the executive and legislative branches, federal regulatory agencies, academia, and at prominent research institutions and think tanks. A number of current CEI staff are former CEI interns.
 
You can find out more about CEI here and learn about our history here. You can see our team of experts here, and see some of our work here and here.

Events interns assist with organizing policy-related events, including webinars, book forums, Capitol Hill briefings, and our celebrated Julian L. Simon Memorial Award Dinner. This hands-on role involves helping with event registration and logistics, designing promotional materials, and conducting topic, venue, and speaker research.
 
Qualifications:
Applicants must have a strong interest in policy and politics, capitalism and economics, and libertarian/conservative principles. Applicants must have strong research, writing, and organizational skills. Applicants must possess a professional demeanor and the ability to handle confidential and private information. Applicants should be able to work independently, effectively, and efficiently. A basic understanding of Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook is a must.
 
CEI also seeks interns to work on policy/research, marketing - and from time to time, philanthropy/fundraising, government affairs, events, litigation, and IT. During the interview, we would be more than happy to discuss these other opportunities if they are available and of interest to you!

title: Hardware Design Team Lead
description:
Hardware Design Team Lead

Bristol, UK

About the job

Lead the engineers behind the power, timing and control circuits that make Graphcore’s AI compute hardware work.

Your team’s schematics, component choices and electrical constraints will give PCB layout engineers complete inputs for implementing each design. You’ll help test and manufacturing teams understand expected behaviour, resolve circuit issues and take hardware through to production.

You’ll line-manage engineers, coach their development and agree achievable commitments, matching the work to available capacity. You’ll coordinate reviews and investigations, ensure corrective actions reach closure and plan ahead for tools, licences and compute resources.

Grow your leadership across the hardware lifecycle, drawing on specialist expertise rather than becoming the technical authority for every circuit. Build a more autonomous team whose methods and shared knowledge improve how Graphcore develops its next generation of hardware.

The team and culture

You’ll connect Hardware Design with SI/PI, PCB layout, mechanical, thermal, systems and firmware engineers across locations. Programme management owns the integrated plan; you’ll flag competing priorities early and bring practical options for resolving them.

Technical owners help agree operating conditions, margins and acceptance criteria. You’ll encourage engineers to challenge assumptions, using evidence and specialist advice to resolve difficult trade-offs.

What we’re looking for

• People leadership that develops engineers, delegates effectively and addresses difficult performance issues, with readiness for formal line management.

• Experience coordinating engineering delivery with programme management, including estimates, work allocation, dependencies and capacity, with sound judgement under schedule pressure.

• Communication that builds relationships across disciplines and locations, resolves competing expectations and secures decisions by explaining risks and trade-offs.

• A strong hardware engineering background spanning circuit and schematic development, board implementation, verification and production transition. An engineering degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Understanding of power supplies, sequencing, reset, clocks, digital interfaces and SI/PI constraints, with judgement about when specialist input is needed.

• Experience organising technical reviews, maintaining traceable design records and ensuring investigations and corrective actions reach a clear conclusion.

While we have outlined a set of requirements, we value transferable skills and diverse experiences. We also welcome engineers returning to the profession after a career break, including through returnship routes.

Benefits

· Flexible working: Balance your work and personal life with greater flexibility
· Generous leave: Take time to rest, recharge and enjoy life outside of work
· Retirement planning support: Up to 5% matched pension
· Phantom equity: Share in Graphcore’s success
· Workplace experience: Enjoy thoughtfully designed office spaces for collaboration, with free food and an on-site barista to support your day
· Peace of mind protection: Income protection and life assurance to provide financial security for you and your loved ones
· Electric Vehicle Scheme: Choose an electric vehicle and lease it through salary sacrifice
· Flexible benefits: Tailor your benefits package with a choice of additional options, including private medical insurance and dental cover
· Optional benefits: Dental cover, health cash plan, private medical insurance, cycle to work scheme, give as you earn

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger - helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.
Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Physician to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care.
You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.
Job highlights
The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.
In this role, you will:

• Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

• Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

• Conduct virtual visits as needed

• Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:
As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.
Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“Many of the people I see are shocked that a physician is coming to their home to visit with them one-on-one. When you sit down and have an unhurried conversation about their health, they are impressed, happy, and understand that their health plan and care team cares about them.” - M.L., MD
The primary care physician gets a snapshot of a person in an office setting, but with Signify Health, we see things like the number of steps to enter their home, the state of disrepair those steps may be in, and the person’s ability to function comfortably and with ease in their own home. We can make referrals to the individual’s health plan, encourage the participation of their loved ones, and ensure their PCPs are aware of their health and overall quality of life.” - C.H., MD

• Malpractice coverage

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Spark Runtime Engineering Team brings Snowflake’s performance, efficiency, and reliability to Spark workloads. Our mission is to help customers scale data processing while preserving the familiar Spark APIs and semantics they rely on. We build the compiler and runtime integration that translate Spark workloads into efficient execution on Snowflake’s cloud-native query engine. This includes tackling complex challenges in compiler infrastructure, query-plan lowering, Spark compatibility, execution integration, and end-to-end observability to deliver faster, more cost-efficient data processing at scale.

In partnership with compiler, query engine, runtime, and product teams, you will turn customer needs into a focused roadmap and measurable engineering outcomes.

- Own the production quality of the team’s components, including observability, incident response, fault recovery, and safe rollout practices.

- Hire, coach, and develop engineers; provide actionable feedback, manage performance, and support career growth across experience levels.

- Validate changes against representative customer workloads and track measurable improvements in compatibility, latency, reliability, and cost-efficiency.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

- 2+ years of direct engineering management experience, with demonstrated success developing engineers and delivering production systems.

- 5+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including substantial work on compilers, query-processing systems, or runtime infrastructure.

- Deep expertise in at least one relevant area, such as compiler architecture and IR transformations, relational query processing, language semantics and type systems, or runtime integration.

At Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Why this role is on the menu
Instacart Business is building the go-to B2B purchasing experience for teams that need fast, reliable delivery of food, office essentials, and last-mile supplies - and we’re still in the early innings. The emerging-market segment is largely untapped, and we need a sharp, entrepreneurial seller to help us define how we reach and win these customers. We’re hiring an SDR II to own full-cycle sales in this segment and directly shape how Instacart Business grows. This role sits at the intersection of outbound hustle and strategic product partnership, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to how we scale from a team of 6 to a market leader.
What you’ll cook up in your first year

• A healthy, self-sourced pipeline of emerging-market logos - built from consistent 40-60 daily outbound touches and 3x+ pipeline coverage - that directly fuels Instacart Business’s new logo growth.

• Net-new closed-won revenue in the emerging segment, from first touch through signed deal, with a track record of meeting or exceeding monthly and quarterly quota.

• Repeatable, tested playbooks for prospecting and closing in the emerging segment - including refined ICPs, A/B-tested sequences, and conversion benchmarks that the broader team can build on.

• Meaningful cross-functional partnerships with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Operations - bringing the voice of your customers into roadmap conversations, pilots, and packaging decisions.

• A reputation as the go-to for emerging-market deal expertise: someone who can run tailored demos, build ROI narratives for multiple personas, and navigate buying committees with confidence.

The secret ingredients we’re looking for
Must-have pantry staples

• 2+ years of B2B sales experience in SDR, BDR, or AE roles, with a focus on outbound prospecting and new logo acquisition.

• 1+ year owning a full sales cycle for SMB or emerging-market accounts, including discovery, demo, negotiation, and close.

• Documented track record of meeting or exceeding quota (pipeline generation and/or closed-won attainment) in recent roles.

• Proficiency with Salesforce CRM and at least one sequencing tool (e.g., Outreach or Salesloft), plus LinkedIn Sales Navigator or similar data enrichment tools.

ABOUT CUBE

Quality & Delivery

Collaboration & Communication

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
We are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to be the founding member of Burq 's Platform team - the function that owns our engineering foundations: infrastructure, security, CI/CD, and reliability.
Right now, our infrastructure runs on AWS with a combination of ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, and Step Functions. Infrastructure

• Lead the Aurora DB production migration with support from our infrastructure advisor

• Manage and evolve our ECS Fargate services, RDS clusters, ElastiCache, SQS queues, and ALB configuration

• Own Terraform - infrastructure as code, not click-ops

Security & Access

• Harden IAM - developer permission sets, production access controls, least-privilege enforcement

• Audit and lock down public S3 buckets

• Enable AWS Config and Security Hub across all accounts

CI/CD & Developer Experience

• Build out PR stack environments so product teams can test independently

• Integrate AI-assisted testing into the CI pipeline

Observability & Reliability

• Own CloudWatch dashboards spanning ALB, ECS, RDS, ElastiCache, SQS, and target group health

• Lead post-incident reviews and ensure every incident produces a runbook entry

• Partner with product teams to distribute platform work as a standing sprint allocation - not a separate queue

Requirements

• 5+ years of engineering experience with 3+ years focused on infrastructure and platform engineering

• Deep AWS expertise - ECS, RDS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, SQS, Lambda, account architecture

Why You’ll Love Working Here

title: (Developmental) Content Editor
description:
About Animalz

Animalz is a content marketing agency that partners with B2B SaaS companies, venture capital firms, and other tech organizations to drive long-term, sustainable growth through high-quality content.

Our fully remote team of experienced content marketers delivers strategies and content tailored to each customer's goals and context. We pride ourselves on our deep interest and understanding of software products and audiences, our commitment to thought leadership, and our relentless pursuit of mastering our craft.

Our customers include industry leaders like Amplitude, Ramp, and Wistia, as well as high-growth early-stage startups.

About the Role

We are looking for a freelance developmental editor to review B2B SaaS content written by our in-house and freelance writers. You’ll focus on long-form content, from SEO/AEO/GEO to thought leadership, though editors are occasionally called upon to review copy for LinkedIn, landing pages, or other formats. 

Editors at Animalz play a key role in ensuring the work we deliver meets our internal bar for quality and helps our clients meet their business goals. You sit between writers and copyeditors, and while you should be able to edit prose at the line level, your primary focus is editing for substance. Does the piece of content you’re editing effectively execute the brief? Is it aligned with the client’s business goals and tailored for their audience? Is it structurally and logically sound? 

To ensure each piece of content we deliver answers these questions, you’ll review content and provide writers with actionable feedback, from big-picture guidance down to inline edits. You’ll be dedicated to a specific pool of customers so you can get deeply familiar with their business and brand and provide feedback that takes into account their holistic strategy, not just each individual piece. 

Requirements

• Experience writing and editing diverse forms of content for B2B tech, especially long-form content (blog posts, ebooks, guides, etc.) 

• Working knowledge of SEO and AEO/GEO best practices. You don’t need to be an expert, but you should know the basics

• Ability to deliver actionable feedback. You can communicate why changes should be made, balancing candor with respect

• Ability to quickly get up to speed on new industries, companies, and products

• Knowledge of and interest in the B2B tech industry and content marketing trends and best practices

• Available 5-10 hours per week (schedule varies; you’ll be expected to deliver edits within 1 business day of receiving an assignment)

Nice to Have: 

• Experience working in-house at a B2B tech company

• Experience developing and executing content strategies 

• Experience as a manager, mentor, or coach for writers (formal or informal) 

Working Arrangements

Location: Fully remote (Americas or EMEA) 

Employment type: Freelancer

Rate: $65/hour
